title: Conversations
description: Each conversation's turns, the harness sessions they ran in and the session workspaces they used, and what those spent, joined by the attributes alasio's telemetry carries: alasio.conversation.id, alasio.session.id and alasio.volume.id.

url_options.data:
select distinct SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] as __text, SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] as __value
from otel.traces where SpanName = 'alasio.turn' and ServiceName = 'alasio' and Timestamp >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and Timestamp < epoch_ms(${__to}) order by 1

panels.title: Conversations
panels.description: Each conversation with a turn in the time range: its turns, its harness sessions (alasio.session.id) and the output tokens their transcripts count, and the session workspaces (alasio.volume.id) its turns ran in.

url_options.data:
with turns as (
select SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] as conversation, SpanAttributes['alasio.harness'] as harness, SpanAttributes['alasio.session.id'] as session,
nullif(SpanAttributes['alasio.volume.id'], '') as workspace, Timestamp, (StatusCode = 'Error' or SpanAttributes['alasio.turn.outcome'] = 'failed') as failed
from otel.traces where SpanName = 'alasio.turn' and ServiceName = 'alasio' and Timestamp >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and Timestamp < epoch_ms(${__to}) and SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] in (${conversation:sqlstring})
),
sessions as (select distinct conversation, session from turns where session is not null),
claude as (select s.conversation, sum(m.output_tokens) as tokens from sessions s join claude.messages m on m.session_id = s.session group by 1),
codex as (select s.conversation, sum(u.output_tokens) as tokens from sessions s join codex.token_usage u on u.thread_id = s.session group by 1)
select t.conversation, string_agg(distinct t.harness, ', ') as harnesses, count(*) as turns, count(*) filter (where t.failed) as failed,
max(t.Timestamp) as last_turn, count(distinct t.session) as sessions, string_agg(distinct t.workspace, ', ') as workspaces,
coalesce(any_value(claude.tokens), 0) + coalesce(any_value(codex.tokens), 0) as output_tokens
from turns t left join claude using (conversation) left join codex using (conversation)
group by 1 order by last_turn desc

select time_bucket(to_milliseconds(${__interval_ms}), Timestamp) as time, SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] as conversation, count(*) as turns
from otel.traces where SpanName = 'alasio.turn' and ServiceName = 'alasio' and Timestamp >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and Timestamp < epoch_ms(${__to}) and SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] in (${conversation:sqlstring}) group by all order by 1

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Each harness session (Claude Code's session id, Codex's thread id) with a turn in the time range, joined to its transcript: claude.messages, codex.token_usage.

url_options.data:
with sessions as (
select SpanAttributes['alasio.session.id'] as session, any_value(SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id']) as conversation, any_value(SpanAttributes['alasio.harness']) as harness,
count(*) as turns, min(Timestamp) as first_turn, max(Timestamp) as last_turn
from otel.traces where SpanName = 'alasio.turn' and ServiceName = 'alasio' and Timestamp >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and Timestamp < epoch_ms(${__to}) and SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] in (${conversation:sqlstring}) and SpanAttributes['alasio.session.id'] is not null group by 1
)
select s.*, coalesce(c.messages, x.responses) as responses, coalesce(c.input, x.input) as input, coalesce(c.output, x.output) as output
from sessions s
left join (select session_id as session, count(*) as messages, sum(input_tokens + coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens, 0)) as input, sum(output_tokens) as output
from claude.messages group by 1) c using (session)
left join (select thread_id as session, count(*) as responses, sum(input_tokens) as input, sum(output_tokens) as output
from codex.token_usage group by 1) x using (session)
order by last_turn desc

panels.title: Session workspaces
panels.description: Each session workspace (alasio.volume.id) a turn ran in, or whose bayma sent telemetry, in the time range.

url_options.data:
with turns as (
select SpanAttributes['alasio.volume.id'] as workspace, string_agg(distinct SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'], ', ') as conversations, count(*) as turns, max(Timestamp) as last_turn
from otel.traces where SpanName = 'alasio.turn' and ServiceName = 'alasio' and Timestamp >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and Timestamp < epoch_ms(${__to}) and SpanAttributes['alasio.conversation.id'] in (${conversation:sqlstring}) and SpanAttributes['alasio.volume.id'] <> '' group by 1
),
bayma as (
select ResourceAttributes['alasio.volume.id'] as workspace, count(*) as spans, count(*) filter (where StatusCode = 'Error') as failed, max(Timestamp) as last_seen
from otel.traces where ServiceName = 'bayma' and Timestamp >= epoch_ms(${__from}) and Timestamp < epoch_ms(${__to}) group by 1
)
select workspace, turns.conversations, turns.turns, turns.last_turn, bayma.spans, bayma.failed, bayma.last_seen
from turns full join bayma using (workspace) order by coalesce(turns.last_turn, bayma.last_seen) desc
